title: CertStore leaf cert cache: keys, lookup order, eviction
answers: What is the cache eviction policy for certs?
Do --certs custom certs override generated ones?
body:
- `certs.py:CertStore.certs`: dict `TCertId` (str or `(commonname, sans)` tuple) → `CertStoreEntry` (cert, privatekey, chain_file, chain_certs). In-memory only; lost when `TlsConfig.configure` recreates the CertStore.
- `CertStore.get_cert` lookup order, first hit wins: CN and each SAN via `asterisk_forms` (www.example.com, *.example.com, *.com) → literal `"*"` → `(commonname, sans)` tuple. Miss → `dummy_cert`, stored under the tuple.
- Custom `--certs` are registered via `add_cert_file`/`add_cert` under CN, SANs and the spec (default `"*"`), so they beat generated certs (and a `*` custom cert catches everything).
- Eviction: `CertStore.expire` FIFO `expire_queue`, `STORE_CAP=100`; evicting removes all dict keys pointing to the entry.
